document.abstract: A 16mm mechanism designed to advance the film during the vertical blanking time of the television system and its use with a flying-spot film scanner for color television is described. The order of the forces encountered is indicated. Also, solutions to certain auxiliary problems are given as well as operating characteristics and performance data.
